title: The Interactive Media and Gender-related Stressors and Strengths Study
official: The Interactive Media and Gender-related Stressors and Strengths Study Part 3: Feasibility Study
summary: The investigators have been developing an interactive psychoeducational website as a brief preventive intervention to enhance social media literacy. This study will determine if the website is feasible and acceptable to adults.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Reside in United States
* Have access to computer, tablet, or mobile device with internet access

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to understand and read English
